newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Batecor yr share slumps, plans rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Batecor yr share slumps, plans rights issue.

text.p: Income before tax 24.57 loss vs 21.36 profit
Full name: Bateman Industrial Corp Ltd (engineering)

NOTE - The company attributed its loss primarily to the poor performance of subsidiaries Computer Alliance and Metquip in Australia, which together accounted for losses of about 40.3 million rand. The rest of the group produced a profit of 18 million rand.
The company said it planned to proceed with a rights issue to raise 30 million rand in bid to reduce "unacceptably high gearing".
Batecor's holding company Edward L Bateman Ltd had indicated it was prepared to underwrite the issue.

It added that every effort would be made to make Computer Alliance achieve breakeven by year end, while the problems at Metquip had been addressed and the company was now budgeted to trade profitably.
The group was expected to return to profitability in the coming year.
